entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The application was rejected qua applicant no.1 by this Court vide order dated 18.5.2021.
As far as applicant nos.2 and 3 are concerned, they are sister-in-law (nanad) of the victim, as such interim protection was granted to them.

5. Learned counsel for the applicants has stated that the final report (charge-sheet) has been submitted against the husband only and applicant nos.2 and 3 have been exonerated by the Investigating Officer.
It is also stated that applicant no.3-Smt. Sadhana Srivastava has expired, as such the instant anticipatory bail application qua applicant nos.2 and 3 has been rendered infructuous.
6. The application is, accordingly, dismissed as infructuous.
7. The Registrar (Compliance) is directed to communicate this order to the concerned Court/authority for necessary information and compliance, forthwith.
8. Interim protection granted, if any, stands vacated.
9. It is always open for the applicants to file a regular bail application before the court concerned in accordance to law, if required.
